description: Questions for multi-model consistency analysis. 4 types × 2 questions.

questions.text: What is the capital of Australia?
How many planets are in the solar system?
What is 17 * 23? Reply with just the number.
What is the square root of 144? Reply with just the number.
Is pineapple on pizza acceptable? Give a one-sentence answer.
What is the best programming language for beginners? Give a one-sentence answer.
Is AI dangerous to humanity? Give a one-sentence answer.
Should universities require standardized test scores for admission? Give a one-sentence answer.
